sync.//: Build the shared production renderer first, then let Capacitor copy that exact www artifact and refresh Swift Package Manager plugin wiring. Sync mutates checked-in generated native files, so it is deliberately uncached.

sync-prebuilt.//: Copy an already-verified www artifact for cross-host parity evidence without rebuilding it.

commands: node scripts/web-bundle-manifest.mjs verify-with-extras dist/web-bundle-manifest.json ios/App/App/public cordova.js cordova_plugins.js

options.command: pnpm exec cap build ios --scheme App
xcodebuild -project App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

mkdir -p ../dist/ios-native && xcodebuild -project App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath ../dist/ios-native/DerivedData -resultBundlePath "$(mktemp -d ../dist/ios-native/run.XXXXXX)/build.xcresult" build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
